analyticalQuestion: Does the one-degree weighted Wiener restart certify a larger common analytic radius, and do every active, ball, residual, and transport inequality close with exact positive margin?
supportedClaim: On the active support cone q>=-1, one total-degree weight gives the all-order bounds ||Phi(f)||<=3||f||^2 and ||D Phi(f)h||<=6||f||||h||. At radius 16/243, the exact degree-40 polynomial has weighted norm 0.15865694927073253935 and complete residual norm 2.999049187948959763e-46. The exact rational ball maps strictly into itself with Lipschitz upper bound 0.97597084781219761804. The canonical normalized transport fields extend on the same radius. The bivariate radius gain is 4/3 and the fixed-charge radius gain is 64/27.

chartContract.family: normalized comparison bars plus threshold lollipops and a logarithmic residual-scale dot plot
variants: paired old-versus-new horizontal bars normalized to the R0.31 bivariate and fixed-charge radii
four dimensionless contraction checks against the common threshold one
two-scale logarithmic comparison of the exact residual and all-order allowance
chartContract.takeaway: The weighted restart gives a genuine all-order radius gain, every contraction quantity is below threshold, and the exact residual is about 42 orders of magnitude below its allowance.
chartContract.dataSufficiency: Four exact radius rows, four exact contraction metrics, and two exact residual scales; the small row count is intentional because every point is a named theorem quantity rather than a sampled trend.

chartContract.finalSurface: single double-column journal figure at 178 by 98 millimetres, with PDF, SVG, and 600 dpi PNG exports

simulation.configuration: R0.31 majorant K=81/4; support cone q>=-1; one-total-degree weighted Wiener norm; exact degree-40 restart at r=16/243; exhaustive admissible basis pairs through degree 12; exact degree-12 support-cone Jacobian block
simulation.precision: gmpy2.mpq exact rationals backed by GMP 6.3.0; decimal fields are display-only
simulation.solver: deterministic formal-series recurrence, exact support-pair audit, exact residual evaluation, rational contraction inequalities, and rational triangular matrix inversion

caption.chineseSiteSummary: 一阶总次数权重把支持锥上的二次算子变为同半径有界映射。四十阶精确重启把共同解析半径从 4/81 提高到 16/243；完整残差只占收缩余量约 2.08e-42。

qa.notes: The PDF page is exactly 178 by 98 mm and the 600 dpi PNG is 4204 by 2314 pixels. The color export, true grayscale conversion, and a 200 dpi Poppler render of the PDF were inspected. Hatching, open versus solid bars, four marker shapes, and a dashed threshold preserve distinctions without color. Titles, axes, direct labels, legend, logarithmic scale, and three footer lines are unclipped.
